title: EastWest Dream Run 2026 Manila Review: What the Manila Leg Was Like
seo_title: EastWest Dream Run 2026 Manila Review | Filinvest City
meta_description: EastWest Dream Run 2026 Manila review: nearly 7,000 at Filinvest City on 2 August, sold-out 21K and 5K, a dog run, a recovery lounge and P500,000 in raffles.
dek: EastWest Bank's race series opened its second year at Filinvest City, Alabang, on 2 August 2026, with nearly 7,000 people. Here is what the Manila leg was like, from the report on it.
verdict: The EastWest Dream Run Manila is a big, family-friendly bank race with a proper half marathon attached. Nearly 7,000 runners, families and dogs gathered at the Filinvest Event Grounds on 2 August 2026 for the opening leg of the four-city series [1]. The 21 km and 5 km sold out before race day [1]. Kenya's Evans Bomer won the men's 21 km, ahead of SEA Games medallist Arlan Arbois, and Marickz Camacho won the women's [1]. After the race there was a recovery lounge with massages and more than P500,000 of raffle prizes [1]. If you want a festive, well-stocked half marathon in the south of Metro Manila, register early.

sections.heading: The 2026 Manila Leg
paragraphs: Nearly 7,000 runners, families, friends and dogs gathered at the Filinvest Event Grounds in Alabang for the first leg of the 2026 series, organised by RunRio [1]. It was the event's second year [1].
There were five categories: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km and a 1 km dog run [1]. The 21 km and the 5 km both sold out before race day [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Evans Bomer of Kenya won the men's 21 km, with Arlan Arbois, a SEA Games medallist, second [1]. The women's podium was all mothers: Marickz Camacho, who was breastfeeding at the time, won ahead of Jocelyn Elijeran and Nikka Panlaqui [1].
Further back, runners came in costume, and the 1 km dog run was the crowd favourite [1].

sections.heading: After the Finish
paragraphs: The race village had sponsor activities, games, giveaways and food, and the EastWest Horizons Recovery Lounge offered post-race massages and recovery sessions [1]. EastWest and its partners gave away more than P500,000 in raffle prizes, from staycations to fitness equipment [1].
The series went on to Clark on 30 August, Iloilo and Cagayan de Oro [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a half marathon in Metro Manila that the whole family can join, yes. The spread of distances, the dog run and the recovery lounge make it a full day out, not just a race.

Register early. Two of the five categories sold out before race day in 2026 [1]. The only account of the day is from the organisers' side, so it says nothing about course conditions or water stations.
This review is compiled from a published report on the 2026 Manila leg. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.
